title: Ripgrep
description: A mock repo of Rust, JS and Markdown you can search live — type a pattern and watch matches light up while files under node_modules, target and .git stay skipped, just like a real .gitignore. Every flag you flip rebuilds the actual rg command above the results.
intent: A tunable, preset-driven panel in the same vein as Ink and Tuner, demonstrating a real dev tool's mechanic through flat Swiss-poster styling instead of a skeuomorphic terminal skin.
